entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: Non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D (X3D) Graphics standard.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: The previous major version of the X3D standard.

entities.name: VRML97
entities.note: The predecessor to the X3D standard, also known as Virtual Reality Modeling Language.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: GL Transmission Format, a 3D file format commonly used alongside or converted to/from X3D.

entities.name: USD
entities.note: Universal Scene Description, a 3D framework and format developed by Pixar.

entities.name: X3D XML Encoding
entities.note: The XML-based file format for X3D scenes (.x3d).

entities.name: X3D JSON Encoding
entities.note: The JSON-based file format for X3D scenes.

entities.name: X3D ClassicVRML Encoding
entities.note: The classic VRML-style plain text encoding for X3D scenes (.x3dv).

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: A primary open-source authoring tool for X3D scenes.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A popular open-source 3D creation suite that includes X3D export/import add-ons.

entities.name: MeshLab
entities.note: An open-source system for processing and editing 3D triangular meshes, supporting X3D.

entities.name: Aopt
entities.note: A powerful command-line tool for 3D model optimization and conversion, part of InstantReality.

entities.name: view3dscene
entities.note: A viewer and converter for X3D and VRML models, built on Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: An open-source cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine heavily utilizing X3D.

entities.name: Titania
entities.note: An open-source X3D editor and viewer.

entities.name: X3DJSONLD
entities.note: A tool and library for converting and loading X3D JSON files.

entities.name: x3d-tidy
entities.note: A command-line tool to format and convert X3D files.

entities.name: X3DJSAIL
entities.note: X3D Java Scene Access Interface Library, providing Java bindings for X3D.

entities.name: X3DPSAIL
entities.note: X3D Python Scene Access Interface Library, providing Python bindings for X3D.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework for integrating X3D into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: An open-source WebGL-based X3D player for web browsers.

entities.name: X3D Schematron
entities.note: A set of Schematron rules for validating X3D XML files.

entities.name: X3D XML Schema
entities.note: The official W3C XML Schema (XSD) for validating X3D XML documents.

entities.name: X3DUOM
entities.note: X3D Unified Object Model, an XML representation of the X3D standard used to generate tools.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key architect of the X3D standard and maintainer of X3D-Edit.

entities.name: John Carlson
entities.note: A developer active in the Web3D community, known for work on X3DJSONLD.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: The creator of Castle Game Engine and view3dscene.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: A US Navy institution that hosts and develops many X3D tools.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: A German research institute that developed X3DOM and InstantReality/Aopt.

entities.name: Extensible 3D (X3D) Graphics working group
entities.note: The primary working group within the Web3D Consortium advancing the X3D standard.

entities.name: Web3D 2023
entities.note: The 28th International Conference on 3D Web Technology.
